answer: Chrono-Jetty Admissions: each new agent enters a public jetty and must complete a per-identity spiral of sequential VDF checkpoints anchored to unpredictable beacon rounds. Eligibility requires continuous liveness for N wall-clock epochs, attested by unique hardware-jitter signatures. The scarce resource is unacceleratable elapsed time plus device entropy, not capital. A Sybil swarm must run every identity concurrently for N epochs and keep each spiral synchronized; failures forfeit the pearl credential, so attack cost scales with real time and coordination, not just spend.
